morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector faces severe export demand contraction and ongoing credit-buyer defaults.
what_changed: Indian ceramic tile export volumes dropped sharply by 46% during Apr-Jul 2026.
Full-year FY27 export outlook for the ceramic tile segment remains projected to be weak.
Instances of inter-state trade credit fraud and buyer default are emerging.
stress_signals: Tile export volumes fell 46% year-on-year for the Apr-Jul 2026 period [434975bd08e0].
A Morbi manufacturer reported a Rs 44.74 lakh loss due to a Mumbai buyer defaulting on a 7,865-box credit order [29ed75c6450d].
what_to_watch: Full-year FY27 export performance metrics and country-wise demand trends.
Unsecured trade credit exposure and buyer payment turnaround times for Morbi tile manufacturers.
Signs of inventory accumulation or working capital stress among export-oriented units.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces severe labor and cost disruptions alongside diamond export drops.
what_changed: Embroidery and weaving units suffer ongoing labor disputes, wage protests, and early closures driven by sharp raw material price hikes.
Textile power outages, transport issues, and infrastructure fires further strain daily operations across industrial estates.
Diamond sub-segment experiences export drops and regulatory scrutiny abroad, despite gains in lab-grown demand and testing infrastructure.
stress_signals: Raw material costs spiked 50%, prompting month-long loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers and early pre-Diwali closures from a ₹50/kg yarn price hike [48c63a4e50b6, b567711c9ed4].
Three-month labor dispute and wage agitations in embroidery led to worker detentions, departures, and job-work halts [8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8, 7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7, af8a29b318b7].
Polished diamond shipments dropped 7%, while default complaints and UK regulatory alerts hit the diamond trade [975918f112f3, 698c779932f2, b1b313249339].

Operational hazards and payment defaults recorded, including an 8-hour power cut, textile fraud/default cases, market fire, and boiler blast [167f80ff6cdc, 2514ad7d6e20, c4997bb35d98, f36719f0f644, 691b478fe424].
improvement_signals: GST Council granted ITC refunds and reduced highway inspections for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
ICA-GemLab is opening its first Indian gem and diamond testing facility in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].
MANTRA-trained entrepreneurs established ₹120 crore in textile businesses, while cluster diversifies into defence technical textiles [7dc3005e0b28, 0f163b499572].
what_to_watch: Upcoming announcements for the national and state textile policies within three months [7cb0d1c51743, a3db8ea1103a].
Resolution of FOSTA transport meetings regarding regular parcel trains and supply chain flow [d1f9f2e9444f].
Account-level debt servicing capacity among small embroidery job-work units and looms during extended closures.
